description:
An agentic IDE that helps you do your best work with features such as specs, steering, and hooks.

Kiro is an agentic IDE that helps you go from prototype to production with spec-driven development. From simple to complex tasks, Kiro works alongside you to turn prompts into detailed specs, then into working code, docs, and tests—so what you build is exactly what you want and ready to share with your team. Kiro's agents help you solve challenging problems and automate tasks like generating documentation and unit tests. With Kiro, you can build beyond prototypes while being in the driver's seat every step of the way.
Workflows, Safer Untrusted Workspaces, and Enterprise Sign-In Controls
Run reusable multi-agent Workflows in the background, apply stronger safeguards to Kiro configuration, and manage enterprise sign-in options.
IDE 1.2 introduces Workflows, strengthens safeguards for untrusted workspaces, and adds enterprise controls for sign-in methods. This release also reworks session details, keeps enterprise traffic in your profile's Region, and fixes authentication, debugging, and reliability issues.
Run multi-agent Workflows in the background
Ask Kiro to run a reusable, multi-step plan while you continue in the parent chat. Each step runs in its own agent session. Use the Workflows area above the chat to inspect progress, open a step, and pause, resume, or stop the run. Workflows are off by default: turn on Workflows in Workspace Configuration in Agent Focus, or set kiroAgent.workflows.enabled in Settings, then start a new chat session. Learn more ->
Protect Kiro configuration and Workflow recipes
Kiro asks before the agent changes agent, Hook, or Power files, or the Workflow recipes in .kiro/workflows/ that define your Workflows, even when broader file permissions allow the write. In an untrusted workspace, Kiro also asks before changing any other Kiro configuration and before each command runs, even when you previously allowed it. Workflow recipes in an untrusted workspace are not loaded until you trust the workspace. Learn more ->
